skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Gain a deep understanding of the working environment in the IT industry.
Apply theoretical knowledge to solve real-world problems in a business setting.
Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of current IT solutions, identify challenges, and propose improvements.
Install and configure basic software and hardware systems based on business requirements.
Work effectively in teams to complete assigned projects and tasks.
Develop critical thinking and evaluation skills for technology solutions.
Build professional relationships with industry experts and expand career opportunities.
Manage and execute projects assigned by instructors or businesses.
Engage in discussions, ask and answer questions, and present ideas effectively.
Write comprehensive and structured reports after practical training sessions.
